title: That betrayal?
paragraphs: That betrayal? That heartbreak? That difficult boss? It wasn't wasted time. It was training ground.

God never wastes a single encounter. As the image says, everyone has a role. The ones who tested you built your endurance. The ones who used you taught you discernment. They were all necessary steps to forge you into the warrior you are becoming today.
Don't curse the lesson just because it was painful. Kneel down, thank God for the training, and stand up ready for the mission.
⚔️ "And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose." - Romans 8:28
